title: 美伊签署谅解备忘录 缓解市场压力 油价回落至80美元
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: On the Iran deal, we now have the MOU signed, it seems.
segments.zh: 关于伊朗协议，谅解备忘录似乎已签署。

segments.en: Are you pleasantly surprised how the global economy has coped with this in the sense of how high oil prices got, how stocks managed to keep performing,
segments.zh: 全球经济如何应对油价高涨和市场表现，您是否感到惊喜？

segments.en: or in any terms you define? A huge pleasant surprise.
segments.zh: 以任何标准衡量，都是巨大的惊喜。

segments.en: I thought we had probably six to eight weeks after the war started before we would start to see visible raching in Europe
segments.zh: 我以为战争开始后六到八周，欧洲就会出现明显衰退。

segments.en: once the ship stopped arriving. And the reality is, households, businesses, markets have made numerous
segments.zh: 但现实是，家庭、企业和市场做出了许多渐进调整。

segments.en: incremental adjustments as a result of these supply dislocations and continue to expand production.
segments.zh: 由于供应中断，他们继续扩大生产。

segments.en: The markets have passed a major test, right? I mean, if the Hormuz straight is going to be shut for three and a half months and the oil prices sort of peak at 120 and then settle at about 80.
segments.zh: 市场通过了重大考验：霍尔木兹海峡关闭三个半月，油价峰值120后稳定在80。

segments.en: That's success. That's success, that's a major test pass, right?
segments.zh: 这是成功，通过了重大考验。

segments.en: If this genuinely holds, look at earnings, right? I mean, it's certainly better that any of us around the table would have thought.
segments.zh: 如果这真的成立，看看盈利，比我们任何人预期的都要好。

segments.en: Here we are with earnings having been upgraded and with corporate showing resilience.
segments.zh: 盈利被上调，企业展现出韧性。

segments.en: So, you know, we're thinking about this world where effectively the more chaotic the politics becomes, the more government spend.
segments.zh: 我们思考这样一个世界：政治越混乱，政府支出就越多。

segments.en: Physical stimulus is driving growth. That's driving corporate profitability.
segments.zh: 实物刺激推动增长，进而提升企业盈利能力。

segments.en: Whilst the conflict has been occurring, fuel prices have been incredibly high.
segments.zh: 冲突期间，燃料价格一直居高不下。

segments.en: The short term we might see some, some sharper pricing, but I think that what we are going to see is that the market will normalise quite quickly.
segments.zh: 短期内可能看到更剧烈的价格波动，但市场将很快恢复正常。
